body.message:
Good morning. As a holiday home company, you are expected to provide at least one extra bedsheet set so guests can change the linens when needed. My friends staying in other apartments in the same building already have this, so I believe this is part of your responsibility as well.

Also, I have been informing you for several days about multiple issues in the apartment, but nothing has been resolved yet. The bathroom ceiling is still leaking, and my previous message was not even answered.

Please keep this in mind regarding future rent payments too. Respect goes both ways — when guests are treated with respect and their concerns are handled properly, the same respect is returned. But if my concerns continue to be ignored, I will deal with future payments and the apartment handover accordingly.
